President Assents to Anti-Paper Leak Law, Fast-Track Courts Designated

President Droupadi Murmu has granted assent to an amendment enhancing punishments for unfair means in public examinations, effectively enacting a tougher anti-paper leak law. This law aims for stricter punishments and speedier probes. In parallel, the Calcutta High Court has designated five fast-track courts specifically for NEET 2026 paper leak cases. Additionally, reports indicate a transfer of 138 judges in Delhi, including those hearing NEET cases, with new judges assigned to special courts for NEET paper leak matters.
